design_direction: A command room for human connection: precise enough for work, warm enough for community. Fuse Swiss information design, broadcast control rooms, and tactile audio hardware without copying Discord.

discovery.content_strategy: Use concise labels, visible status, message grouping, and progressive disclosure. Make the active conversation the scene; supporting navigation should feel like a calibrated instrument panel.

design_options.name: Signal Room
design_options.description: Obsidian command center with bone text, signal orange actions, compact mono metadata, and warm amber presence dots. Swiss grid plus audio-console controls.

design_options.name: Night Transit
design_options.description: Midnight navy surfaces, electric cyan as functional signal, coral for alerts, with route-map separators and station-like channel naming.

design_options.name: Studio Relay
design_options.description: Charcoal canvas with paper-white message surfaces, red editorial annotations, and waveform-like dividers. Editorial layout fused with broadcast production UI.

design_options.name: Copper Static
design_options.description: Warm black, muted copper, parchment accents, and restrained grain. Tactile hi-fi equipment meets old-money tech; premium without gradients.

design_options.name: Field Grid
design_options.description: Blue-black utility shell, safety yellow only for active state, pale gray content, and exposed 1px grid borders. Industrial field operations meets social messaging.

research.adaptation: Borrow structural clarity, not brand color or Discord conventions. VEXOR uses asymmetric emphasis, an editorial active-channel header, and tactile status controls.

typography.reason: Condensed display gives VEXOR a broadcast/control-room voice; Plex Sans stays highly legible; mono makes realtime state feel instrument-like.
rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings.
H1 text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl maximum, tracking-tight, leading-none.
Body text-sm mobile and text-base desktop, leading-relaxed.
Use font-[350] for quiet labels and font-[850] for major impact.

colors.archetype: Swiss & high-contrast with a warm hardware twist
rules: No full-screen gradients; use flat layers, grain, and borders.
Primary orange is reserved for CTA, active send, and one key status at a time.
Danger is never the only indicator; pair with text or icon.
Verify normal text at 4.5:1 and large text at 3:1 minimum.

visual_enhancers.grain: Use a subtle fixed noise texture at opacity 0.025, pointer-events-none, aria-hidden=true.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px tinted borders and exposed grid seams; no excessive shadows.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces for data and chat. Use crystal glass only for sticky nav, modals, and toasts with bg-[#181C1F]/90, backdrop-blur-xl, backdrop-saturate-150, and an inner border.
visual_enhancers.scrollbar: Customize narrow scrollbar thumb #3A4446 on track #111416; no gutter.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react, 16-20px, never emoji. Audio icons should be paired with labels in critical controls.
visual_enhancers.texture_rule: Use rough grain against smooth UI to create human tactility; keep decoration under 20% of visible area.

implementation_guidance_js: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for landing layout; use existing shadcn primitives for dialogs, dropdown menus, inputs, tabs, sheets, toasts, and forms.
Customize existing UI primitives rather than adding rigid generic cards.
Use sonner from src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or the existing local convention for feedback.
Use WebSocket for presence/messages in MVP; WebRTC controls are entry points and preparation only, not a fake connected call.

grids.workspace: Mobile-first grid-cols-1; desktop grid-cols-[72px_248px_minmax(0,1fr)_248px], gap-0, visible seams. Keep direct grid children.
grids.landing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with gap-8 to gap-12. Mix hero 8 columns, square 4, tall 4, and offset filler; leave breathing room.
grids.admin: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-4 or gap-6. Primary data spans 2 columns and member/moderation feed is tall.
grids.mobile: Use Sheet for rails, bottom navigation for primary destinations, and never let images exceed max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none.

layouts.landing: Solid header with logo, 4 desktop links, CTA; asymmetric left-aligned hero; product screenshot/illustration as a close-up; feature grid; realtime proof; contrast-shift footer.
layouts.auth: Left editorial statement and right solid form panel on desktop; single-column form on mobile; use shadcn Input/Form and explicit validation.
layouts.workspace: Community rail -> channel rail -> active thread -> member/presence rail. Top bar names context and exposes search, invite, and voice-ready actions. Composer is anchored but never transparent.
layouts.dm: Use the same thread mechanics with a quieter Copper Static surface; keep recipient status and safety actions visible.
layouts.settings: Left settings navigation, dense bordered sections, role matrix and moderation log. Use Dialog/DropdownMenu/Select primitives, not native select.

motion.entrance: Stagger rails and thread sections 40ms apart; translate 8px and fade in.
motion.hover: Buttons use transform translateY(-1px), background-color and color transitions only; message actions fade in on row hover.
motion.presence: Online dot softly pulses once on status change, never continuously for all users.
motion.loading: Use skeleton rows and an understated three-bar typing indicator.
motion.reduced_motion: Wrap nonessential animation in prefers-reduced-motion and reduce duration to 1ms; do not remove focus or status feedback.
motion.rule: Never use transition: all. Always define specific properties.

requirements: Every button, link, input, menu, key metric, presence status, confirmation, and error needs a kebab-case data-testid.
Keyboard focus uses a 2px high-contrast ring; never rely on color alone.
Use aria-label for icon-only controls and aria-hidden=true for decoration.
Announce new messages and connection errors with aria-live.
Respect reduced motion and maintain readable contrast over every surface.

media.instruction: Do not add stock photos or placeholder URLs. VEXOR can be distinctive with CSS grain, SVG waveform marks, avatars generated from initials, and product UI close-ups. If future media is requested, use image_selector_tool only.

3d_libraries.reason: MVP success depends on scanability and realtime communication, not immersion.
3d_libraries.future: If a marketing hero later needs depth, lazy-load React Three Fiber with Suspense and transparent canvas; keep adequate lighting and do not compromise auth/workspace performance.

realtime_architecture_visual_contract.websocket: Show connection state as text (Connected, Reconnecting, Offline) with data-testid; optimistic messages must show pending state and retry affordance.
realtime_architecture_visual_contract.webrtc: Show microphone, voice room, system audio, and screen-share entry points as prepared controls. Clearly label unavailable/not connected states until signaling and media permissions are implemented.
realtime_architecture_visual_contract.auth: Email/password now; visually reserve Google as a disabled future provider only if product copy explicitly explains it is coming later.

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Every page has a visible, readable navigation context; desktop links remain visible.
Never use a fully transparent header or overlay under content; use solid or glass surfaces with blur and border.
Avoid generic centered layouts, uniform cards, simplistic gradients, and excessive rounded corners.
Use generous spacing: p-6/p-8 for bordered containers, py-20 or py-32 for major sections.
Left-align reading content; center only when it improves a deliberate composition.
All interactive elements have hover, pressed, focus, and disabled states with explicit text color.
Use only primary color for key CTAs; preserve neutral hierarchy elsewhere.
Use Sonner for toasts; use Shadcn Dialog, DropdownMenu, Select, Calendar, Sheet, Tabs and Form for advanced interaction.
Never use assistant emoji as icons.
Test at mobile, tablet, desktop, keyboard navigation, reduced motion, and offline/reconnecting states.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Signal Room as the primary direction. Treat the workspace as a real product shell, not a static mock: preserve API boundaries, WebSocket events, auth states, error/loading/empty states, and test IDs. Keep WebRTC visibly prepared but do not claim a working call unless signaling and media permissions are real.
